description: Creates a new account in Salesforce with the specified information. Returns the created Account's ID at `data.response_data.id`.

account_source.human_parameter_description: How you first learned about or acquired this account (for example, Web or Referral). Useful for tracking lead sources.
account_source.title: Account Source

annual_revenue.human_parameter_description: Enter the company’s estimated yearly revenue. Use this to gauge account size and prioritize efforts.
annual_revenue.title: Annual Revenue

billing_postal_code.human_parameter_description: Postal or ZIP code for the billing address.
billing_postal_code.title: Billing Postal Code

billing_state.description: Billing address state/province. For US/Canada addresses, use full state/province names (e.g., 'California', 'New York', 'Ontario') or abbreviations ('CA', 'NY') which are auto-converted. For other countries, leave empty unless you know the exact valid picklist value for your Salesforce org. WARNING: If State/Country Picklists are enabled in your org, only pre-configured values are accepted; arbitrary region names will be rejected with FIELD_INTEGRITY_EXCEPTION.
billing_state.human_parameter_description: State or province for the billing address. For US/Canada, use full names like 'California' or 'New York' (abbreviations are auto-converted). For other countries, leave empty unless you know the exact valid picklist value configured in your Salesforce org.
billing_state.title: Billing State

billing_street.human_parameter_description: Street address for billing. Use the exact address where invoices should be sent.
billing_street.title: Billing Street

custom_fields.description: Custom fields to set on the account. Use Salesforce API field names (e.g., 'Level__c', 'Languages__c'). Values can be strings, numbers, booleans, or null.
custom_fields.human_parameter_description: A dictionary of custom field values to set on the account. Use the Salesforce API names for custom fields (ending in __c). This allows setting organization-specific fields that aren't part of the standard Account object.
custom_fields.title: Custom Fields

fax.human_parameter_description: The company’s fax number, if applicable.

industry.human_parameter_description: Choose the industry the company operates in. This helps with segmentation and reporting.
industry.title: Industry

name.human_parameter_description: The official name of the company or organization you want to create in Salesforce. This is required so people can find and recognize the account.
name.title: Name

number_of_employees.human_parameter_description: How many people work at the company. Useful for sizing and targeting.
number_of_employees.title: Number Of Employees

parent_id.description: ID of the parent account if this is a subsidiary. Must be a valid Salesforce Account Id (15- or 18-character).
parent_id.human_parameter_description: If this company is part of a larger organization, provide the parent account’s Salesforce ID. Use this to link subsidiaries to their parent company.
parent_id.title: Parent Id

phone.human_parameter_description: The main phone number for the company. Include country code if outside your region.
phone.title: Phone

shipping_postal_code.human_parameter_description: Postal or ZIP code for the shipping address.
shipping_postal_code.title: Shipping Postal Code

shipping_state.description: Shipping address state/province. For US/Canada addresses, use full state/province names (e.g., 'California', 'New York', 'Ontario') or abbreviations ('CA', 'NY') which are auto-converted. shipping_state.human_parameter_description: State or province for the shipping address. For US/Canada, use full names like 'California' or 'New York' (abbreviations are auto-converted). For other countries, leave empty unless you know the exact valid picklist value configured in your Salesforce org.
shipping_state.title: Shipping State

shipping_street.human_parameter_description: Street address for shipping. Use the location where goods or materials should be delivered.
shipping_street.title: Shipping Street

sic_desc.human_parameter_description: Brief description of the company's SIC category. Helps standardize industry classification.
sic_desc.title: Sic Desc

type.human_parameter_description: Select what kind of relationship this company has with you, like Customer, Partner, or Prospect. This helps categorize and report on the account.
type.title: Type

website.human_parameter_description: The company’s website address. Helps teammates learn more about the business.
website.title: Website

errors.description: Array of error objects. Empty array when success is true. Contains error details when success is false.

id.title: Id

success.description: Indicates whether the create operation was successful. Returns true if the Account was created successfully, false otherwise.
success.title: Success
